description_en: Queries the tags bound to resources
description_zh: 调用ListTagResources查询资源绑定的标签列表
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the resource to which the tags to be queried are bound.
If you want to query the tags of a topic or a group, you must specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
需查询的标签所绑定资源所在的实例ID。
如果您需查询的是Topic、Group的标签，则必须填写该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

INSTANCE
TOPIC
GROUP
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。枚举类型。取值如下：

INSTANCE
TOPIC
GROUP
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The token used to start the next query
parameters.name: next_token

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource.

If you specify this parameter, the value cannot be an empty string.
The value can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. The value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。

若输入该参数，则参数取值不允许为空字符串。
最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource.

If you specify this parameter, the value can be an empty string.
The value can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. The value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。

若输入该参数，参数取值允许为空字符串。
最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of tags. The list can contain up to 20 elements
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表。列表元素个数不得超过 20
parameters.name: tag

NextToken.description_en: The token used to start the next query

RequestId.description_en: The common parameter. The ID of each request is unique and can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题

TagResources.description_en: The collection of resources and their tags, which includes information such as the resource ID, resource type, and tag key-value pairs
TagResources.description_zh: 由资源及其标签组成的集合，包含了资源ID、资源类型和标签键值等信息

ResourceType.description_en:
The resource type.

ALIYUN::MQ::INSTANCE: The resource is an instance.
ALIYUN::MQ::TOPIC: The resource is a topic.
ALIYUN::MQ::GROUP: The resource is a group
ResourceType.description_zh:
资源类型。

ALIYUN::MQ::INSTANCE：表示资源类型为实例。
ALIYUN::MQ::TOPIC：表示资源类型为Topic。
ALIYUN::MQ::GROUP：表示资源类型为Group
